name: Discrete Diode — 19V — D
description: Cluster of 14 discrete 19V diodes (zener and TVS types) in D-family footprints, covering SOD-123, SOD-123F, MicroMELF, MiniMELF, and DO-15/DO-35 axial packages, mostly from Alternate-KiCad-Library.
selection_hints: Match the exact footprint (SOD-123, SOD-123F, DO-15, DO-35, MicroMELF, MiniMELF, or 5W axial) to the intended land pattern
Confirm whether the specific part is a zener or TVS diode before substituting one for the other
Prefer tier A entries (13 of 14 parts) over the single tier B entry
Note source library (Alternate-KiCad-Library vs JLCPCB-Kicad-Library) when weighing trust
avoid_when: The needed footprint is not one of the listed D-family patterns
A zener-specific or TVS-specific function is required and the part type is not confirmed
Only through-hole or only SMD mounting is acceptable and the candidate part's mount type is unverified
Symbol-footprint pairing has not been checked against the source datasheet
